title: Payoff Quotes, Per Diem and Lien Release — Kestrel Auto Finance
content:
Payoff quotes on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts are issued to the borrower or to a dealer buying the vehicle, on these rules.

## Quote rules

1. A payoff quote is issued only on a contract whose status is active, as the contract record shows.
2. The good-through date is the quote date plus the tier's payoff quote validity days.
3. The quoted amount is the principal balance plus fees due plus daily simple interest from the last payment date through the good-through date, rounded to the cent. The interest days are the calendar days from the day after the last payment date through the good-through date, and the daily interest is the principal balance times the APR divided by the tier's day-count basis.
4. The per diem stated on the quote is one day of interest on the principal balance, rounded to the cent.
5. A payoff received after the good-through date must include the per diem for each later day.

## Closing

6. The contract is paid off when a payoff payment brings principal, interest and fees to zero.
7. The lien release is sent within the tier's lien release business days, and any overpayment is refunded to the borrower within the tier's overpayment refund business days.
8. Paying off a contract ends any Kestrel GAP Waiver attached to it.

## Worked quote (hypothetical figures)

Principal balance 8500.00, APR 12.09 percent, day-count basis 365 days, fees due 25.00, last payment date 2026-06-20, quote date 2026-07-04, validity 10 days:

- Good-through date: 2026-07-14.
- Interest days: 2026-06-21 through 2026-07-14, that is 24 days.
- Interest: 8500.00 times 12.09 percent, divided by 365, times 24 days, is 67.57 (the total is rounded once, at the end).
- Quoted amount: 8500.00 plus 25.00 plus 67.57, that is 8592.57.
- Per diem: 8500.00 times 12.09 percent, divided by 365, rounded to the cent, that is 2.82. A payoff received on 2026-07-16, two days after the good-through date, must include two days of per diem, 5.64.
